articles.title: Australia warns H5N1 likely to spread after first mass mortality episode - Al Jazeera
articles.description: Agriculture minister says testing confirmed H5N1 bird flu in a group of 49 dead and 35 sick terns.
articles.content: Australia has warned that H5N1 bird flu is likely to spread further, after the countrys first mass mortality episode among seabirds killed about 50 greater crested terns off the coast south of Adelai… [+1622 chars]
